name: Deepglow Skate
oracle_text: When this creature enters, double the number of each kind of counter on any number of target permanents.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, double the number of each kind of counter on any number of target permanents.

needs.what: an op that, for each object in `objects`, reads every kind of counter currently on it and puts that many more of each kind on it (doubling each kind independently, including counters of kinds not known at authoring time), used with a target of `up_to` any number of permanents
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_counters takes a single named `counter` kind, so it cannot iterate over whatever kinds a permanent happens to carry; `counters_on` reads only a named kind; move_counters has `all_kinds` but moves between objects rather than adding a copy of each kind to the same object; proliferate adds only one of each kind and is itself a known simplification; for_each iterates objects, not counter kinds
